paragraphs: Located in the heart of Cary, we offer a refreshing dental experience for families.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Cary office! Our office stands out with its modern atmosphere and advanced technology, making your dental experience stress-free. Our skillful and attentive team strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we designed our office and amenities with your health and well-being in mind. Our patients feel supported and at ease, leaving motivated and confident to care for their oral health.

Our Cary location is conveniently situated in a suburban community, just off US Route 1. It offers small-town charm with easy access to WakeMed Cary Hospital and Koka Booth Amphitheater. We provide care for the Cary community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Picardy Pointe, Holly Springs, Garner, and more. Our connection with clients goes beyond the dental chair. You are now part of the Riccobene family, where we are committed to providing the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, painless smile!
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Cary office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!
We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
At Riccobene Associates Family Dentistry, we are committed to personalized, high-quality dental care focused on patient comfort, advanced technology, and lifelong oral health.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Cary office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
Select a Location to schedule an appointment:
Call our Cary Family - Crescent Green Office at 919-858-0088, or use the form below to request an appointment.

Dr. You Seen Seo was born in South Korea, raised in Vancouver, and earned her DDS from NYU in 2019. Accepted into a seven-year dental program in high school, she’s practiced in Illinois, New York, and previously Garner, NC. Known for her gentle, preventive approach, Dr. Seo values patient comfort and education. Outside work, she enjoys family time, cooking, knitting, and exploring coffee shops. She speaks English and Korean.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What services do dentists in Cary offer?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How often should I visit the dentist?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

Are emergency dental services available in Cary?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do dentists in Cary accept dental insurance?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Why choose Riccobene Associates Family Dentistry in Cary?

At Riccobene Associates Family Dentistry, we are committed to personalized, high-quality dental care focused on patient comfort, advanced technology, and lifelong oral health.
